prompt: De niño, ___ mucho. (As a child, I used to eat a lot.) [comer]
We always used to go to the park. → Siempre ___ al parque.
hint: Ir is irregular in the imperfect: iba, ibas, iba, íbamos...

prompt: ___ las tres cuando llegó. (It was three o'clock when he arrived.) [ser]
hint: Time in the past uses ser imperfect: eran las tres.

prompt: She was tall and had long hair. → Era alta y ___ el pelo largo.
hint: Ongoing past description uses imperfect: tener → tenía.

prompt: Siempre ___ en casa los domingos. (They always stayed home on Sundays.) [quedarse → quedarse, ellos]
